tasks.title: Vercel config, environments manifest, env check, CI + QA smoke + security + uptime workflows, release workflow (token A), runbook
tasks.description: Per ops-platform, ops-environments, ops-ci, ops-observe and ops-release: vercel.json (region yul1, the four ghl-sync crons at 00/06/12/18 UTC and housekeeping at 07:30 UTC, git.deploymentEnabled.main false); infra/environments.json declaring Preview/Production rows and every env var NAME from docs/architecture.md plus CI names (VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET, SUPABASE_PRODUCTION_DB_URL, staging test keys); .env.example updated to match (names only); scripts/env-check.mjs that fails when APP_SIGNING_SECRET or CRON_SECRET is missing from Preview or Production (names only, values never read; SEC-4), with --manifest-only (compares manifest, code and .env.example without calling Vercel) and --self-test (a fixture missing CRON_SECRET must fail); scripts/install-scanners.sh (pinned, checksum-verified actionlint, gitleaks, opengrep, osv-scanner); .github/workflows ci.yml (verify, api-tests on the staging DB, a security job that runs the scanners via install-scanners.sh, actionlint), qa-smoke.yml on staging deploys, uptime.yml at a frequency inside GitHub Free minutes, and release.yml behind the GitHub production environment applying migrations with SUPABASE_PRODUCTION_DB_URL (Matthew's token A: no Supabase personal access token anywhere), prebuilt production deploy, read-only smoke, automatic Instant Rollback; scripts/smoke.mjs (read-only /api/health check, exits non-zero unless 200); docs/runbook.md with the 3A password procedure (min length 12, reauthentication on, Baseleap sets and resets passwords in the dashboard), the no-custom-SMTP rule (SEC-10), incident, rollback and secret rotation. Drop SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD and SUPABASE_PRODUCTION_REF if the connection string makes them redundant (ruling).
acceptance: vercel.json has region yul1, exactly five cron entries matching architecture.md, and main Git deploys turned off
env-check --self-test fails on a manifest missing CRON_SECRET; --manifest-only passes on the real manifest
no workflow or doc references SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN or supabase db push
every workflow passes actionlint, has least-privilege permissions and pins actions to a full SHA
runbook covers 3A passwords, no custom SMTP, release, rollback and secret rotation

tasks.title: Backend platform + public submission: env, form token, http/log/events, createQuoteRequest, submitQuoteRequest, spam refusals, health, housekeeping
tasks.description: Thin route handlers over services per docs/openapi.yaml and architecture.md Modules, replacing A2's typed stubs. env.ts fails closed under 32 characters (invariant 15); X-Form-Token HMAC issue/verify; http.ts problem+json wrapper with PostgREST error mapping and {error_class, code}-only logging (SEC-5); allow-listed log.ts; events.ts (ids only). createQuoteRequest: email trimmed before validation; marketing_consent coerced with value === true, never 422 (AC-001.17); maps start_quote_request outcomes (created 201, replayed 200, updated 200 after clearing uploads, token_used 409 form_already_used, rate_limited 429 with Retry-After; 23505 on submission_key = replay); IP hashed per SECURITY_MODEL Network address (IPv6 /64); record_spam_refusal after honeypot/time-trap/rate-limit refusals, errors ignored, identical refusal either way; a request is accepted when the rate counter can't be read (AC-003.5). submitQuoteRequest with photo magic-byte/size/dimension checks then complete_quote_request; photo_upload_failed event; the after() GHL attempt only when a job was queued (via the integration seam). 503 on both form-token routes when APP_SIGNING_SECRET is missing or short. /api/health. Housekeeping job route behind CRON_SECRET (Bearer undefined/empty/missing = 401) purging stale pending requests and all counter tables incl. spam_refusal_windows and sign_in_pauses. Staging-backed tests fail (never skip) when env is missing.
acceptance: every response matches the contract schema; 4xx bodies are problem+json
AC-001.17: marketing_consent 'maybe', 1, null or missing is stored as false with no 422
a forced 23514 on create leaks no name, phone or email into the log line or response (SEC-5)
Bearer undefined, empty and missing each give 401 on /api/jobs/housekeeping; a short APP_SIGNING_SECRET gives 503 on create and submit
20 parallel creates from one address accept exactly 5 (against staging)
out_of_scope: GHL client and its routes (INT1, INT2)
verify: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/api/submission tests/api/housekeeping tests/api/health tests/unit/env --passWithNoTests=false

tasks.title: GHL core: typed client, contact copy by match rule, stage tags, job runner + seam, offline GHL simulator

Deterministic GHL stub in tests/mocks/ that QA reuses offline. No live GHL calls.
